name: VidyBack
category: AI Social Media Automation Software for Ecommerce
description: VidyBack connects to an online store's product catalog and automatically generates branded Instagram Reels, TikTok videos, and social media posts, removing the need for manual video editing or content design.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Limited templates, 50 AI credits/month, 480p export, watermarked output

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 1,000 AI credits/month, brand kit, scheduled posting

targetAudience: Solo founders and small marketing teams without dedicated video editors
coreFeatures: AI-generated Instagram Reels and TikTok videos from product photos
Custom brand kit (logo, colors, fonts) applied automatically to every post
contentOwnership: Users retain full ownership of AI-generated content with a lifetime license for unlimited use and sharing.
